text:
alex: Opening a phased apply window for infra release v2026-04-12. Target window 22:00-23:30 UTC. Scope: NAT gateway replacements (staged), IAM role/policy pinning, and a couple small route updates. @priya @jonathan please ack and own canary/iam respectively.
priya: ack. I'll run the NATGW canary and watch healthchecks. first canary ETA 22:15.
jonathan: ack. I'll run the IAM diffs and prepare the manual approval step. doing a quick terraform plan in staging now.
deploy-bot: Deploy schedule created: infra-apply-1925002468. Canary sequence: us-west-2a -> us-west-2b. Auto-rollback threshold: 10% error rate or healthcheck failure.
maria: quick callout - any cross-account assume-role changes require manual approval. recommend we insert a hold between NATGW canary and IAM apply.
alex: good catch. Adding a manual approval gate after NATGW canary. Proposed sequencing: 1) canary NATGW via targeted apply, hold & verify 2) IAM plan review + manual approval 3) IAM apply 4) finish remaining NATGW AZs.
jonathan: plan snippet from staging: 
```
# terraform plan snippet
+ aws_iam_role.service_invoke
~ aws_nat_gateway.ngw[0] (replace)
```
Replacement for NATGW will cause brief egress interruption; metrics will show it.
priya: will route canary traffic through secondary private subnet during replacement and keep extra healthchecks on CDN.
ops-bot: Reminder: maintenance tagging required: #infra-maintenance. PagerDuty routing set to sre-oncall.
alex: Rollback criteria (explicit): 1) >5000 5xx across regions within 5m, 2) p95 latency increase >0.5s on inference paths, 3) IAM deny spike above baseline. If triggered: pin modules to previous versions, restore terraform state snapshot, and flip DNS back.
maria: snapshot state before apply: `terraform state pull > state-1925002468.backup.json` then `aws s3 cp state-1925002468.backup.json s3://redwood-terraform/backups/1925002468.json`.
priya: preflight checklist: lb healthchecks ok, route53 TTL lowered to 30s, canary workspace ready, cloudwatch alarms configured.
jonathan: I've set the manual approval DM and will be on standby.
alex: timeline reminder: 21:50 lower TTL, 22:00 start natgw canary, 22:20 review metrics, 22:30 manual approval for IAM, 22:35 apply IAM, 22:45 proceed with remaining natgw AZs.
deploy-bot: At 22:00 UTC: starting step: canary apply module.natgw in workspace 'prod-canary'.
maria: note from staging run earlier: we saw ~2min brief packet loss on replacement. priya's routing change fixed it; verified.
jonathan: IAM changes are a small tightening of assume-role policy; will include a rollback plan and dry-run results in the release notes.
priya: after canary is green, I'll run `terraform apply -auto-approve -target=module.natgw[1]` for next AZ.
alex: rollback runbook quick ref: `/runbook infra/rollback/natgw-iam` steps: 1) pin module versions in tfvars, 2) restore state from backup, 3) flip route53 records back, 4) roll back service config if necessary.
ops-bot: Rollback runbook configured. If rollback invoked, channel #incidents will be opened and PG will be notified.
maria: logging timeline entries and artifacts to the incident timeline doc.
jonathan: pushed release notes draft: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-04-12-infra - will update post-apply.
alex: thanks all — starting window shortly. :thumbsup:
